'''BG-J38''' was a [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drone]] that served as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] personal [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] and hologames [[Droid/Legends|droid]].

==Biography==
[[File:Beegeeblack.jpg|thumb|left|100px|BG-J38]]
BG-J38 was a [[J9 worker drone/Legends|J9 worker drone]] manufactured by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines]], a company founded by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] which also produced the [[8D8/Legends|8D8]] series of droids and the [[8D smelter droid]]. BG-J38 shared the torso and leg design with the 8D smelter droid.

While Jabba had originally purchased him as a labor unit, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] guards discovered that his [[Arjan II logic computer]] made him a perfect hologame opponent. From then on he was used to provide entertainment for the Hutt and soon became one of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] best [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]], often seen playing one of the [[Slot machine/Legends|slot machines]] at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. He was unbeaten in almost every game, but never won a match against his master. After [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] death at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] BG-J38 disappeared to find new opponents to challenge himself.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
BG-J38 was sold by [[Hasbro]] as one of their "Build a Droid" figures.
